01About me

Curious by nature.
Precise by practice.

I am an AI student in my final semester, focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into systems people can actually trust and use. My work sits at the intersection of engineering, experimentation, and thoughtful evaluation.

At Bauhaus Luftfahrt, I develop AI-assisted MATLAB workflows and study local and cloud-based language models for technical engineering processes. I care about the full journey: from a structured experiment to a robust integration.
